text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! How's that? Proves you don't need 
a prestigious pedigree to make a name for 
yourself, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"We can all shake hands! Know that bonds 
are something you can nurture♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
By putting on a magnificent performance 
and going toe-to-toe with Mejiro Dober, 
Seeking the Pearl proved her potential.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent run that was, 
Pearl-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family is my pride. It's a 
wonderful thing, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
So Pearl-san has them around her, too. 
Someone she feels a family-like bond 
with...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I guess that counts as a "family" too. 
Your family is truly wonderful as well.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Their family...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Why are you acting like a stranger? You're 
already part of my family too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh, I'm part of the family too!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I don't possess such a minimal 
capacity of mind as to reject someone just 
because they belong somewhere else.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's welcome, joining other families 
is okay too! Eventually, everyone in the 
world will be part of my family!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the "Pearl Family"! Member 
number two: Mejiro Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The Pearl Family... Member number two...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it is a little frustrating... Not 
being in first place, that is.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, sorry, but I already had prior 
plans.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The first person who ever wanted to show 
my potential to the world, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl winks in my direction. 
And so, the fierce battle against the 
Mejiro family in the Junior Class came to 
a close.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, right on schedule, Trainer. Looks 
like we'll be expanding the Pearl Family 
more and more from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hm, was I mistaken? Well, whatever. I'll 
just consider it a side effect of aiming 
for the world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Dober is member number 2, and Bright is 
number 3. The family just keeps on 
growing. Which means..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
First off, there's only one thing to do 
next year.
choice_data_list: Um, what is that one thing?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it obvious?! Cherry blossom viewing! 
Let's go see the cherry blossoms in full 
bloom.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Onward to the Oka Sho! There's no problem 
with that, right, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho. The first leg of the Triple 
Tiara, running at a distance of 1,600 
meters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neither the race's prestige nor the 
distance poses any problem at all. In 
fact, the conditions are practically 
ideal.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's head to the Oka Sho!
Alright, let's head to the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer! From here, the infinite 
possibilities will expand even further.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The Classic year is my runway to the 
world! I'm gonna sprint right down it with 
everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!
